questions.prompt: Which oath includes "having been appointed a (grade in which appointed) in the United States Air Force"?
questions.explanation: Only the Officer Oath has the appointment line.

questions.prompt: Which oath includes "I will obey the orders of the President of the United States and the orders of the officers appointed over me"?
questions.explanation: Only the Enlisted Oath includes obeying the orders of the President and the officers appointed over you.

questions.prompt: In both oaths, you swear to support and defend the Constitution against:
choices: all enemies of the United States
all who would do it harm

questions.prompt: Complete the Officer Oath: "that I take this obligation freely, ..."
choices: without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion;
questions.explanation: "that I take this obligation freely, without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion;"

questions.prompt: Complete the Officer Oath: "and that I will well and faithfully discharge the duties ..."
choices: of the office upon which I am about to enter.
assigned to me by my commanders.
according to the Uniform Code of Military Justice.
questions.explanation: "and that I will well and faithfully discharge the duties of the office upon which I am about to enter. So help me God."

questions.prompt: The Enlisted Oath says orders are obeyed "according to regulations and ..."
choices: the Uniform Code of Military Justice.
the Constitution of the United States.
questions.explanation: "...according to regulations and the Uniform Code of Military Justice. So help me God."

questions.prompt: Both oaths include "that I will bear true faith and ..."
questions.explanation: "that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the same;"
Both end with "So help me God."
